chunks.title: I designed a 150+ assertion AI evaluation dataset
chunks.content:
I designed a 150+ assertion AI evaluation dataset
Vantage Circle · 2024–26 · Product Manager / Product Owner Result: LLM Eval Dataset — 150+ prompt-level assertions across AI answer use cases. A PM-led evaluation system for AI answers: define the test data, make quality measurable assertion by assertion, and use the results to guide iteration. Problem: Teams needed a repeatable way to measure whether AI answers met the needs of each use case—not just whether an answer sounded plausible. Approach: As PM, I designed a dataset of prompts, golden data and multiple assertions per prompt, with an evaluation criterion and pass/fail outcome for each assertion. I partnered with engineering and Microsoft’s evaluation team to run the set, review results and iterate across use cases. Outcome: The latest reported assertion pass rate was 89%, up from a 75% baseline (+14 percentage points), across an evaluation library of 150+ assertions. The result was validated by Microsoft’s partner team. Skills shown: Eval dataset design, LLM-as-judge, CSAT / DSAT, AI-DLC.

Projected avg. increase, India 2026 · 9.1% · Up from an actual 8.9% in 2025 · Attrition · 16.2% · Close to pre-COVID levels · Organisations surveyed · 1,400+ · Across 45 industries (Aon 2025-26) · Labour Codes threshold · ≥50% · Basic + DA share of total remuneration. Why. Increment volume is stable, not shrinking. Aon's 2025-26 Annual Salary Increase and Turnover Survey, covering more than 1,400 organisations across 45 industries, projects an average increase of 9.1% for India in 2026, up from an actual 8.9% in 2025. Attrition has settled at 16.2%, close to pre-COVID levels. Every one of those organisations runs a cycle, and most of them run it on a spreadsheet. Regulatory trigger. India's Labour Codes require basic pay plus dearness allowance to constitute at least 50% of total remuneration.
